FN-QCHQ15-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 20
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/20/2023
House Bill 20 as introduced could decrease receipts to the Department of Conservation and
Natural Resources (DCNR) and the Department of Environmental Management (ADEM) by an
undetermined amount dependent on the difference in (1) the amount of fees collected for
permits issued for the construction of bulkheads or seawalls to certain property owners at half of
the fee rates otherwise charged, and (2) the amount of fees collected under current practice.
Page 1

FN-QCHQ15-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 20
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/05/2023
House Bill 20 as reported by the Committee on State Government could decrease receipts to the
Department of Conservation and Natural Resources (DCNR) and the Department of
Environmental Management (ADEM) by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference
in (1) the amount of fees collected for permits issued for the dredging of sand and source
sediment to be used for the construction of a living shoreline, and from the number of
consistency determinations issued by ADEM to certain property owners at half of the fee rates
otherwise charged and (2) the amount of fees collected under current practice. According to
DCNR over the last two years there have been seven bulkhead permits and 17 living shoreline
permits issued resulting in an estimated $5,000 in permit fees collected.
